mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: seeing nerves and blood routes connect the regions brought the earlier parts together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the eye and ears was clear but fairly predictable; their places and nerve connections were already shown.

surprise.text: The diaphragm separating the chest from the abdomen made the layout easier to picture.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. Some fittings followed named spaces or offered pairings, rather than requiring me to figure out a new connection.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue if another chapter explored how the assembled systems work together, though the final assembly itself was mostly predictable.
